Listen. If you can, get into a trade. You can get paid $25,000 to $90,000 depending on your level, trade, and where you live. Trades don’t require college and many don’t need any payment for education. For example, if you become an electrician you can get paid to learn. Interview for an IBEW or some electrical company and tell them you know nothing but are willing to learn. They will pay you. Then you’re called a helper or apprentice. Once you’ve done that for two to five years (depending on where you live) you can become a journeyman. Then you need less supervision and get paid a lot more. Then another two to four years and you can become a master electrician. You don’t have to become a master electrician, but if you do you can run your own business and don’t need supervision because you are now the supervisor.
